text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Today the world is marvelous too☆ Tomorrow 
and the day after will be marvelous as 
well★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
You never waver, do ya? Though it's great 
that you're always so full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Man in Black Suit A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. You are Marvelous Sunday-san, 
if I am not mistaken?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hold on, who're you? Super suspicious... 
With those sunglasses and all.

text_block_list.name: Man in Black Suit A
text_block_list.text:
In fact, our agency received reports that 
mysterious phenomena occur around 
Marvelous-san...

text_block_list.name: Man in Black Suit A
text_block_list.text:
To study these occurrences, we would very 
much like to invite Marvelous-san to our 
country.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Marvelous☆!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: No no no, why are you happy about this?!

text_block_list.name: Man in Black Suit B
text_block_list.text:
Hold it right there, taking the lead on 
your own isn't fair!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Don't multiply!! Jeez—!!

text_block_list.name: Man in Black Suit B
text_block_list.text:
I am from an intelligence agency across 
the continent! Our country is also 
prepared to welcome Marvelous-shi!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Then, as if waiting for their cue, 
mysterious agents emerge one after another 
from the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Man in Black Suit B
text_block_list.text:
Nations across the globe desire 
Marvelous-shi's visit. What is your 
response?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Amazing! I get to spread marvelousness 
across the entire world☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
But if I stay with just one organization, 
it won't spread marvelousness properly, 
which is quite a dilemma☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Plus, running in races is marvelous☆ If I 
go with you, I can't race, and that would 
be un-marvelous★ So I have to decline for 
now☆

text_block_list.name: Man in Black Suit A
text_block_list.text: However, your aptitude is—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Kuku. Allow me to offer some well-meaning 
advice. Such research is nearly 
impossible! It will end in vain.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
To begin with, it's doubtful whether it 
even fits into the framework of science.

text_block_list.name: Man in Black Suit B
text_block_list.text:
Kuh... Even so, we must—! ...Now that it 
has come to this, forceful measures are 
our only option!

text_block_list.name: Men in Black Suits
text_block_list.text: !! Wh-Where are we!?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I want everyone to remember the initial 
feelings of when they sought the 
marvelous☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The beauty of the world, being born into 
it, there must have been marvelousness in 
all of it☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
The marvelous is always inside your heart☆ 
So everything is fine even if I don't go 
with you★

text_block_list.name: Man in Black Suit B
text_block_list.text:
Th-This is the marvelous!! What a gentle 
world... It's beautiful☆

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Didn't I tell you? It would be in vain.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, while sharing a table at 
a cafe, Nice Nature and Marvelous Sunday 
shared that story with me.
choice_data_list: What happened to the agents after that?
What happened to the agents after that?
I'm glad you weren't taken away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, while sharing a table at 
a cafe, Nice Nature and Marvelous Sunday 
shared that story with me.
choice_data_list: What happened to the agents after that?
What happened to the agents after that?
I'm glad you weren't taken away.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
They all said something about spreading 
the marvelous further and headed back to 
their home countries.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Though honestly, I'm not even sure if any 
of that was actually real or not.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: The marvelous will echo across the world☆

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, honestly, if it's Marvelous, I had a 
feeling she'd manage to handle whatever 
happened anyway.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Having the potential to make you think 
that way... that's what's so amazing about 
her.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous possibilities are truly 
infinite☆
